title: isoetes velata var. asturicensis
intro: Isoetes velata var. asturicensis, commonly known as Asturian quillwort, is a rare species of quillwort, a type of vascular aquatic plant that belongs to the Isoetaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Isoetes velata var. asturicensis include soothing digestive discomfort, reducing inflammation, and exerting antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
